reviewer_subject_id: stable reviewer/runtime identifier for the execution being governed
activity: Identity Pass or exact review stage name
notes: Use observable values where available. reviewer_subject_id identifies the reviewer/runtime actually being governed. activity identifies the semantic activity this decision gates. review_revision increments whenever a correction/reopening invalidates prior execution gates. content_bytes is the reproducible byte size of in-scope content used for this decision. remaining_stage_count and remaining_evaluation_count decrease only after work is validly completed and not reopened. Update before Identity Pass, before the first or reopened semantic stage, and at later checkpoints.
